## Part 2 - Data analysis

Let's start by loading the packages we will need:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
```
:::


-   Load the data you saved into the `data` folder and name it `chronicle`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
chronicle20 <- read_csv("data/chronicle20.csv")
```
:::


-   How many opinion articles were published in The Chronicle since the beginning of the semester?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
chronicle20 |>
  filter(date >= ymd("2026-08-24")) |>
  nrow()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 10
```


:::
:::


-   How many unique authors have published opinion articles in The Chronicle since the beginning of the semester and how many articles did they each publish?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
chronicle20 |>
  filter(date >= ymd("2026-08-24")) |>
  count(author, sort = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 7 × 2
  author                                    n
  <chr>                                 <int>
1 Luke A. Powery                            3
2 Remembrances                              2
3 Arnav Jain                                1
4 Charles D. Piot                           1
5 Duke Student Publishing Company Board     1
6 Monday Monday                             1
7 Robert Wallace                            1
```


:::
:::


-   Display the date, title, and author of any article(s) that mention AI in their title.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
chronicle20 |>
  filter(str_detect(title, "AI")) |>
  select(date, title, author)
```
